process.desc: Drill 45-degree angle ports intersecting the water-bearing concrete cracks.

process.title: High-Pressure Injection
process.desc: Pump liquid PU chemical resin under 2,000+ PSI pressure until chemical completely fills the void.

faq.q: What is PU chemical injection grouting?
faq.a: PU injection involves pumping a specialized polyurethane resin under high pressure through mechanical ports into concrete cracks. Upon contact with water, the resin reacts and expands into a dense, flexible rubber foam that permanently plugs the water leak.

faq.q: Is PU injection suitable for HDB inter-floor toilet leaks?
faq.a: Yes! In fact, HDB frequently approves PU injection as an effective, non-invasive solution when neighbors cannot coordinate extensive floor tile hacking.
